source_identity.canonical_title: L'affaire Mila n'intéresse l'extrême droite que parce que les agresseurs sont musulmans

translation.canonical_title: The Mila affair interests the far right only because the aggressors are Muslim
translation.displayed_title: The Milla affair interests the far right only because the aggressors are Muslim
translation.summary: The far right is utterly indifferent to Milla’s fate and defends her only because her aggressors belong to its favorite scapegoats; this is therefore more a matter of sordid opportunism than genuine concern for a victim. If the harassers had been white and/or belonged to its camp, there is no doubt that the far right would have done what it does with all harassment that serves its interests: applaud.
